# Currencies

Part of the **Support** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List currencies

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/currencies`

Retrieve a paginated list of currencies with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: rates | `rates` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by currency name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[symbol]` | string | No | Filter by currency symbol (partial match) |  |
| `filter[active]` | boolean | No | Filter by active status |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies?include=rates&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies?include=rates&sort=name&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies?include=rates&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies?include=rates&sort=name&page=1"

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

## Create currency

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/currencies`

Create a new currency

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Currency name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `symbol` | string | Yes | Currency symbol (max 10 characters). Must not be greater than 10 characters. |
| `iso_numeric` | string | No | ISO numeric code (max 3 characters). Must not be greater than 3 characters. |
| `decimal_places` | integer | Yes | Number of decimal places (0-10). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 10. |
| `full_name` | string | No | Full currency name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `rounding` | number | No | Rounding precision (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |
| `active` | boolean | Yes | Whether the currency is active. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "USD",
  "symbol": "$",
  "iso_numeric": "840",
  "decimal_places": 2,
  "full_name": "United States Dollar",
  "rounding": 0.01,
  "active": true
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "USD",
  "symbol": "$",
  "iso_numeric": "840",
  "decimal_places": 2,
  "full_name": "United States Dollar",
  "rounding": 0.01,
  "active": true
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'USD',
    'symbol' => '$',
    'iso_numeric' => '840',
    'decimal_places' => 2,
    'full_name' => 'United States Dollar',
    'rounding' => 0.01,
    'active' => true,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "USD",
    "symbol": "$",
    "iso_numeric": "840",
    "decimal_places": 2,
    "full_name": "United States Dollar",
    "rounding": 0.01,
    "active": True,
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="201" />

```json

  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "USD",
    "symbol": "$",
    "iso_numeric": 840,
```
